title: Clean+Stylish 2BR Sleeps 6, Pool, Downtown/Airport
description:
Stay in our stylish townhome in a stunning golf course community, minutes from the airport and downtown Nashville.
Experience the excitement of Music City with a short drive to downtown Nashville (25 min), the Grand Ole Opry (20 min), and more. Shop for what you may need at nearby stores and restaurants (5 min).
Book your stay today and create unforgettable memories in Nashville!
Seasonal Pool: Guests only have access to the pool Memorial Day–August 31 (weather permitting).

The space
The home features:

o	A fully stocked kitchen with everything you need to cook and eat, including complimentary coffee, tea and creamer. 
o	TVs with Apple TV giving you the ability to log into Netflix, Amazon Prime, Hulu, etc. There is the shared TV in the living room as well as an additional TV in one of the bedrooms.
o	Each bedroom has a mobile fan for those who like sleeping with a fan on.
o	Walk in closets in both bedrooms.
o	Private bathrooms in both bedrooms as well as a powder room on the first floor.
o	A washer and dryer for your convenience. 
o	A Beautiful back yard with pond and park view.
o	Rocking chairs on the front porch to relax and unwind after a night on Broadway!

Seasonal Pool: Guests only have access to the pool Memorial Day–August 31 (weather permitting).

Guest access
Our home only has 2 parking spaces available. There is no additional parking unless you park at a local parking lot.
Please make sure to lock your vehicle at night. We are not responsible for any car accidents or theft on the property.
